title: Assistant

deleteAll.confirmBody: This permanently deletes every conversation you have with the assistant, including past ones. This cannot be undone.

disclosure: AI assistant — answers can be wrong. It has no access to your data.

empty.title: Ask about the product
empty.hint: How a feature works, where a setting lives, what a status means. Do not paste passwords or keys.

errorCodes.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errorCodes.TIMEOUT: The assistant took too long to answer. Try again.
errorCodes.INTERNAL: Something went wrong while answering. Try again.

quota.exceeded: You've reached the usage limit for the assistant for now. Try again later.

citations.title: Sources
citations.unavailable: This source is no longer available to you. It may have been updated, unpublished, or your access has changed.

settings.title: AI assistant
settings.description: The persona and instructions the AI assistant follows for everyone in the organization.
settings.providerNotice: The persona and instructions are sent to the external AI provider together with every question anyone in the organization asks. Do not put passwords, keys or personal data here.
settings.personaPlaceholder: You are Ava, the helpdesk assistant of Acme.
settings.personaHint: Who the assistant is and how it sounds. Up to {{max}} characters.
settings.instructionsPlaceholder: Mention that urgent requests go to the helpdesk. Prefer step-by-step lists.
settings.instructionsHint: What to emphasize, tone and level of detail. Up to {{max}} characters.
settings.boundaries: The assistant's built-in limits always apply and cannot be changed here: it has no access to your data, cannot perform actions, does not guess beyond the documentation, and answers in the language of the question.
settings.enabledHint: When off, nobody in the organization sees the assistant. The persona and instructions below are kept.
settings.blocked: The platform operator has disabled the assistant or not enabled it for your organization. You can still edit the persona and instructions; they apply once the assistant is available.

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.description: Your conversations with the assistant will appear here.

page.pastNotice: This is a past conversation. Continue it to ask new questions here.

unavailable.title: Conversation not found
unavailable.description: It may have been deleted, or it isn't yours.

disabled.title: The assistant is turned off
disabled.description: The AI assistant isn't available for your organization right now.
